Elemental Mastery.descriptionOnly: the air and earth bonuses need both you and your foe airborne or touching the ground; fire's +20 ft. is on all its speeds, of which only land speed is written

Lament of Summer's Last Breath.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Lost Passage.descriptionOnly: on a failed save; the Survival penalty is double the caster level

Overlook.descriptionOnly: the +20 doesn't stack with effects that make you sneakier (invisibility, respectful quiet), and not against creatures immune to mind-affecting effects

Probe History.descriptionOnly: no path: the +5 competence bonus is on the one Knowledge check it grants

Shadow of Doubt.descriptionOnly: no path: the –4 (good) and +4 (evil) are on the target's saves against its own effect

Siege Scatter.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are its damage or healing, DCs and saves against it, rolled at the table

Suppressing Stone.descriptionOnly: +1 for every 4 caster levels, +5 at most

Zephyr's Fleetness.descriptionOnly: the +30 foot enhancement bonus to a fly speed it already has is told here
